summary: Posts and pages can be public, members-only, or paid-only, with gated visitors seeing a CTA instead of the body.
detailed_changes: Added visibility on posts and pages with staff controls in the editors.
Public presenters omit HTML for unauthorized viewers and show signup or subscribe CTAs.
Publish-email snapshots for gated posts store excerpt plus CTA, not the full body.
affected_areas: User groups affected: public visitors; members; staff
Public impact: gated content no longer leaks body via article pages or publish email
Internal impact: RSS/listings remain title and excerpt only
